family.template: Bekzod's mother is {k} times as old as Bekzod. Together they are {s} years old. How old is Bekzod?

stem.uz: Bekzodning onasi undan {k} marta katta. Ikkalasining yoshlari yigʻindisi {s} yil. Bekzod necha yoshda?

why.en: Let Bekzod be x years old: x + kx = total, so x = total ÷ (k + 1).

why.ru: Пусть Бекзоду x лет: x + kx = сумма, значит, x = сумма : (k + 1).
